title: Record and replay
description:
Record every message between two programs, then replay them to reproduce a bug.

```
recorded 5 messages to session.log
replay against the server: 5 sent, 5 replies match
replay against a changed server: reply 3 differs ("ok" vs "error: bad id")
```
hints: Pair each `>` entry with the `<` entries that follow it until the next `>` (lesson 6.04).
Escape new lines and non-printable bytes when recording, so one message is always one line.
requirements: Each recorded line: time offset, direction (`>` or `<`) and the message in hex or escaped text.
The replayer sends the `>` lines to a handler function and compares its replies with the `<` lines.
Report the first difference with both values.
stretch: Replay with the original timing to find bugs that depend on speed.
